title: Lupanov offset identities
statement: For natural numbers $n$ and $k$, let $o_Z,o_F,o_C$, and $T$ denote the offsets defined by $o_Z=n+(2^{n-k+1}-1)$, $o_F=o_Z+(2^{k+1}-1)$, $o_C=o_F+2^{2^k}$, and $T=o_C+2^{n-k}$. Then $o_Z+1=n+2\cdot2^{n-k}$, $o_F+1=o_Z+2\cdot2^k$, and the stated formulas for $o_C$ and $T$ hold; moreover, $1\le 2^{n-k}$, $1\le 2^k$, and $1\le 2^{2^k}$.
